1. 1. Export the CSV and extract the single target row (office 4107 / product group 4298) verbatim, together with the header line
  2. 2. Read the target row's live baseline Override Price

  4. 4. Build a minimal 2-line file (header + the one target row) with only the Override Price rewritten
  5. 5. upload it and wait for the import request to return
  6. 6. Assert the import request is accepted (HTTP 200), then reload and assert the target's Override Price equals the modified value
  7. 7. Canary: re-select office 1105 and assert its full row set is intact (a minimal import upserts only the rows in the file, so a location absent from the file must keep every row)

  9. 9. reload and assert the Override Price is back to the original
